## Fictional retention
At Nerith Sky Workshop, observation cards are kept for 70 days. If a coordinate review is open, retain the affected cards until the review is closed, even after the 70-day period.

## Fictional copy requests
At Nerith Sky Workshop, a public copy request received before 15:30 is sent the same operating day. At or after 15:30, send it on the next operating day. If the publication review is unresolved, do not send the copy until that review closes.
